instruction: Please help me modify the setting of VS Code to keep my cursor focused on the debug console when debugging in VS Code, instead of automatically focusing back on the Editor.

action:
# Reflection: VS Code is open on the Welcome page and no setting changes are visible yet. I will set debug.focusEditorOnBreak to false so debugging does not steal focus back to the editor, then open User Settings JSON to confirm.
import os, re, time, pyautogui
home = os.path.expanduser("~")
candidate_paths = [
os.path.join(home, ".config", "Code", "User", "settings.json"),
os.path.join(home, ".config", "Code - OSS", "User", "settings.json"),
os.path.join(home, "snap", "code", "current", ".config", "Code", "User", "settings.json"),
os.path.join(home, "snap", "code", "common", ".config", "Code", "User", "settings.json"),
]
paths = [p for p in candidate_paths if os.path.isdir(os.path.dirname(p)) or os.path.exists(p)] or [candidate_paths[0]]
for path in paths:
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
try:
text = open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8").read()
except FileNotFoundError:
text = ""
pattern = r'("debug\.focusEditorOnBreak"\s*:\s*)(true|false|null|"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"|[-+]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)'
if not text.strip():
new_text = '{\n    "debug.focusEditorOnBreak": false\n}\n'
elif re.search(pattern, text):
new_text = re.sub(pattern, lambda m: m.group(1) + "false", text, count=1)
else:
idx = text.rfind("}")
if idx == -1:
new_text = '{\n    "debug.focusEditorOnBreak": false\n}\n'
else:
before, after = text[:idx].rstrip(), text[idx:]
insertion = ("\n" if before.endswith("{") or before.endswith(",") else ",\n") + '    "debug.focusEditorOnBreak": false\n'
new_text = before + insertion + after
open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(new_text)
pyautogui.click(960, 540)
time.sleep(0.2)
pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "shift", "p")
time.sleep(0.5)
pyautogui.write("Preferences: Open User Settings (JSON)", interval=0.01)
time.sleep(0.2)
pyautogui.press("enter")
time.sleep(0.8)

import os, re, time, pyautogui
home = os.path.expanduser("~")
dirs = [
os.path.join(home, ".config", "Code", "User"),
os.path.join(home, ".config", "Code - OSS", "User"),
os.path.join(home, "snap", "code", "current", ".config", "Code", "User"),
os.path.join(home, "snap", "code", "common", ".config", "Code", "User"),
]
for d in dirs:
os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
path = os.path.join(d, "settings.json")
try:
text = open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8").read()
except FileNotFoundError:
text = ""
if not text.strip():
text = '{\n    "debug.focusEditorOnBreak": false\n}\n'
elif '"debug.focusEditorOnBreak"' in text:
text = re.sub(r'("debug\.focusEditorOnBreak"\s*:\s*)(true|false)', r'\1false', text)
else:
i = text.rfind("}")
text = (text[:i].rstrip() + ("" if text[:i].rstrip().endswith("{") else ",") + '\n    "debug.focusEditorOnBreak": false\n' + text[i:]) if i >= 0 else '{\n    "debug.focusEditorOnBreak": false\n}\n'
open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(text)
pyautogui.click(960, 540)
time.sleep(0.3)
pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", ",")
time.sleep(1.0)
pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "a")
time.sleep(0.1)
